rationale: The workflow already implements the dependency-download cache described by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE: `actions/setup-node` uses `cache: 'npm'` keyed to `slides/package-lock.json`, which is the equivalent of a separate `actions/cache` dependency step. That pattern's contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" applies, so adding another cache would be redundant. No other pattern fits safely: the workflow includes a deployment job (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE contraindicates release/deployment work), has no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST and P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST not applicable), no schedule (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE not applicable), a single job (no reordering/gating benefit), and no test suite to prioritize or select. Build and test coverage is preserved as-is, so no change is warranted.
